completion_data.completion_summary: Upgraded /pr command task-mode in 5 phases: fixed hardcoded state.json path bug, added pr-description.md loading with pr_title/pr_body/base_branch extraction, redesigned STEPs 5/8/9/10 for task integration, added STEP 10b for post-PR status transition, and updated cslib project scripts to support pr_ready status.

artifacts.summary: Full implementation summary with all 5 phases completed
STEP 2 bug fix + enhancements; STEP 5/8/9 task-mode redesign; STEP 10 base_branch; new STEP 10b

memory_candidates.content: When upgrading multi-mode commands (task/path/description), preserve path-mode and description-mode by adding task-mode conditional blocks BEFORE the existing interactive flows (not replacing them). Use `has_pr_description` style boolean flags loaded in the early STEP to branch mode behavior cleanly.

When adding pr_ready status support to a project's update-task-status.sh: (1) update the validation guard to include 'pr_ready', (2) add preflight:pr_ready -> pr_ready/PR READY and postflight:pr_ready -> completed/COMPLETED to map_status(). Also add pr_ready) printf '%s' "PR READY" to generate-todo.sh format_status() to avoid the uppercase catch-all rendering PR_READY incorrectly.
